answer: Each identity must weave one opal-threaded ceremonial sash on a registered loom, the opal bead stamped with a serial number and the thread dyed in a single batch; an inspector checks the sash at the nadir of the weaving season against the loom's log. One sash costs about $240 in opal, thread and loom time, and registered looms are few, so each extra fake pays more as loom slots fill.
